entries.what: Brakes lab at Tamsen Valley 8-11, then lunch in the truck. Between classes he worries about the Civic deal and sits in the Taco typing out how to quietly tell Dante he's out if the first car loses money.
entries.outcome: Decides to keep it low-key and not say anything yet

entries.what: Afternoon errands for Gladys, picking up supplies at Ruiz Family Market and chicharrón pork from Chuy.
Pickup soccer at Delgado Park in the evening, then teardown videos in bed.
Veterans Day, college closed. Slept in, then helped Oscar fix the stand generator at home.
Listened to his G1 voice-memo flashcards in the truck while driving to Ximena's, where he did a quick brake check on her Corolla.
entries.outcome: Brakes fine; they got horchata afterward

entries.what: Evening at home, studying flashcards and eating dinner with his parents.
entries.outcome: Got through two chapters of cards

entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11 at Tamsen Valley, cleaned his bay carefully because Salas docks points for mess.
Lunch with Dante on campus; Dante pitched the next auction pick again and Rafael held to labor-only terms.
entries.outcome: Left the talk open for later

entries.what: Afternoon flashcard practice, then filled the truck at the Ruel Road station and checked the forecast for tomorrow's storm.
entries.outcome: Planned to prep the stand the next day

entries.what: Storm day. Engine performance class 1-4 with Salas while rain flooded Ruel Road; Rafael asked how to sandbag the stand area so his mom wouldn't have to lift anything and then hauled tarps and sandbags himself.
entries.outcome: Stand secured with tarps and sandbags

entries.what: The family closed the stand that night because of the storm, and Rafael stayed home with the family to watch the rain.
entries.outcome: Lost a night of sales but nothing damaged

entries.what: Late night, played flashcards on his phone and watched teardown videos.
Still wet out. Brought Dulce's ride plan together: checked the lot for flooding, then worked a short Friday setup at the new lot.
entries.outcome: Stand reopened though with slow business

entries.what: Left the Ruel Road stand at 8:50 to pick up Dulce from Taquería Colima, back by 9:20.
Closed down the stand and packed the generator.
Ximena's birthday. Morning at the pan dulce bakery, then gave her the gel-manicure gift card.
Dinner out for Ximena before the stand, then went to the stand.
Saturday stand 5-10 p.m. with Ximena helping.
Sunday stand set-up, midday cards study.
Asked how to tell his dad he wants one weekend off before the practice test, then said never mind and dropped it.
Worked the Sunday stand 5-10 p.m.
